definition_used: One or more companies/institutions did not approve one or more parts of the research or publication process(es). RW also uses this reason if the notice mentions a lack of documentation of alleged approval.
semantic_rationale: The definition centers on missing institutional approval for research or publication, which directly implicates authorship/affiliation integrity and editorial governance over required permissions. No specific data or image issues are mentioned, so problem_object is article_general. Process signals reflect institutional investigation and policy enforcement. Actor context is company/institution as the source of approval.
